iron_key.name: Iron key
iron_key.desc: Heavy, old, and cut for a lock that expects to be respected.

brass_gear.name: Brass gear
brass_gear.desc: One tooth short of a full set. Somewhere a machine is missing this.

clay_idol.name: Clay idol
clay_idol.desc: A squat little figure. Its face has been rubbed smooth by thumbs.

grey_stone.name: Grey stone
grey_stone.desc: Fist-sized. Exactly as heavy as it needs to be.

tallow_candle.name: Tallow candle
tallow_candle.desc: Smells of sheep. Burns long enough to matter.

mirror_shard.name: Mirror shard
mirror_shard.desc: Shows the room, mostly. Shows something else at the edges.

jane_letter.name: Jane's letter
jane_letter.desc: 'Whoever finds this: the tower on the ridge was never empty. — J.'

black_seed.name: Black seed
black_seed.desc: Warm to the touch. Nothing that grows should be warm.

cure_note.name: Physician's note
cure_note.desc: Half a recipe against the sickness in the ground. The other half is elsewhere.

copper_coin.name: Copper coin
copper_coin.desc: Worn smooth. Worth nothing to a merchant; worth a wish to a fountain.

iron_weight.name: Iron weight
iron_weight.desc: A foundry weight with a ring on top. Heavy enough to hold a plate down.

sandbag.name: Sandbag
sandbag.desc: Fat, damp, and about the weight of a man's leg.

silver_key.name: Silver key
silver_key.desc: Bright, sharp-cut, and clearly meant to be missed.

bronze_key.name: Bronze key
bronze_key.desc: Dull and plain. Opens something, presumably.

old_fuse.name: Copper fuse
old_fuse.desc: A fat coil of copper in a clay sleeve. Not burnt — yet.

burnt_fuse.name: Burnt fuse
burnt_fuse.desc: Blackened through. Whatever this fed is dead.

clouded_lens.name: Clouded lens
clouded_lens.desc: Milky glass in a brass ring. Everything through it is a blur — in daylight.

tuning_fork.name: Tuning fork
tuning_fork.desc: It hums faintly when you hold it near old stone.

cold_candle.name: Cold candle
cold_candle.desc: Will not take a flame. Stubborn, or waiting.

map_fragment.name: Map fragment
map_fragment.desc: Torn. Surviving labels: '...ARCHIVE — north of the well. ARMOURY — the red door...'

ledger_page.name: Ledger page
ledger_page.desc: 'Levers to be thrown in this order at shift end: THIRD, FIRST, SECOND. Do not deviate. — Foreman.'

golden_idol.name: Golden idol
golden_idol.desc: Heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

lead_shot.name: Bag of lead shot
lead_shot.desc: Small, dense, throwable. Lands where you point it.

raw_meat.name: Raw meat
raw_meat.desc: A hank of something. Anything with a nose would follow it.

fish_scrap.name: Fish scrap
fish_scrap.desc: Heads and tails, still shining. A fish-eater would cross a room for it.

old_bone.name: Old bone
old_bone.desc: Gnawed clean years ago. A dog would still follow it anywhere.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.desc: A black lump of charcoal. Light enough to carry, dirty enough to leave its mark.
